hero.title: FORGED IN DISCIPLINE
hero.body: MARATHAX is India's premier military-style fitness challenge — a test of strength, endurance, speed and mental toughness unlike anything else.

mission.title: FIND INDIA'S FITTEST
mission.body: We believe true fitness is not just about lifting heavy or running fast — it is about doing both, under pressure, when it counts. MARATHAX was built to find athletes who can.

pillars.title: STRENGTH
pillars.body: Functional strength stations test your ability to move heavy loads efficiently under fatigue.

pillars.title: ENDURANCE
pillars.body: Repeated running sections push your cardiovascular system to its absolute limit.

pillars.title: SPEED
pillars.body: Sprint sections reward explosive power and fast-twitch muscle performance.

pillars.title: MENTAL TOUGHNESS
pillars.body: When your body wants to stop, your mind decides whether you do. MARATHAX tests both.

military.title: THE SPIRIT OF A SOLDIER
military.body: Every element of MARATHAX is inspired by military selection and combat fitness tests used by armed forces around the world. The format demands that you keep moving, keep performing, and never quit — regardless of how you feel.
military.quote: The body achieves what the mind believes.
